name: shopee-mock-api
description: Shopee Open Platform API mock server for Odoo integration demo

scripts.test:sdk: bash -c 'PORT=3099 STRICT_SIG=true PARTNER_ID=123456 PARTNER_KEY=test_key_123 node index.js & PID=$!; trap "kill $PID 2>/dev/null; rm -f shopee_mock_state.json" EXIT; sleep 1; cd ../shopee-sdk && SHOPEE_SANDBOX_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3099/api/v2 SHOPEE_SANDBOX_PARTNER_ID=123456 SHOPEE_SANDBOX_PARTNER_KEY=test_key_123 SHOPEE_SANDBOX_SHOP_ID=123456 SHOPEE_SANDBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN=mock_token_123 SHOPEE_SANDBOX_REFRESH_TOKEN=mock_refresh_123 NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules npx jest src/__tests__/integration/ --no-coverage'
scripts.test:python: bash -c 'PORT=3099 STRICT_SIG=true node index.js & PID=$!; trap "kill $PID 2>/dev/null; rm -f shopee_mock_state.json" EXIT; sleep 1; SHOPEE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3099/api/v2 SHOPEE_AUTH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3099/auth python3 ../python-shopee-sdk/test_app.py'
